title: Pickle deserialization (python)
description: Python code reconstructs objects from pickle bytes with pickle.load. Pickle runs callables recorded in the byte stream while loading, so bytes from an untrusted source can execute code. This lexical rule flags the load; the reviewer confirms the source is trusted or switches to JSON or a typed schema with validation.
remediation: Replace pickle with JSON or a typed schema with validation. If pickle must remain for internal state, authenticate the bytes with an HMAC key and verify it before loading.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the pickle load call regardless of where the bytes came from.
